item.title: Explosive material forces evacuation of 50 homes in Lichtenvoorde; Resident arrested
item.description: Authorities evacuated around fifty homes Friday afternoon after explosive material was discovered in a Lichtenvoorde residence. Police also arrested a resident of the property.

item.title: Dutch traffic jams up 3% in 2025; Drenthe sees 85% spike due to German border checks
item.description: Traffic congestion in the Netherlands rose by 3 percent in 2025 compared with 2024, according to the ANWB, based on TomTom data.

item.title: Netherlands sees sunniest Christmas on record, coldest in 25 years
item.description: The Netherlands experienced its sunniest Christmas on record, while also marking the coldest holiday since 2000, meteorologists reported.

item.title: Dutch 6-year-old and 19-year-old severely injured in separate Tirol ski accidents
item.description: Two Dutch tourists—a 6-year-old girl and a 19-year-old man—sustained serious injuries in separate skiing incidents in Tirol, Austria, on Thursday, Christmas Day, authorities reported.

item.title: Massive fire forces evacuation in Hengelo apartment building
item.description: A large fire broke out early Saturday in a flat building on Nico Werkmanstraat in Hengelo, prompting an immediate evacuation, authorities reported.
